description: A major old-wild browsing cervid feeding on mid-canopy foliage, antlerthorn, veilvine, and tender shoots. The Silverbough Hart is hunted by the elves — respected but not sacred — with hunt rarer than Feywoodhorn Stag due to lower population. Antlers from naturally-shed or naturally-died individuals are used for ceremonial items.

ecology.cultural_role: significant respected hunt animal; natural death antlers used ceremonially

name: Silverbough Hart
